stem_text: A constant power delivering machine has towed a box, which was initially at rest, along a horizontal straight line. The distance moved by the box in time 't' is proportional to :-

candidate_solve.derivation: Constant power P = m v (dv/dt). Integrating from rest: P t = 1/2 m v^2 => v proportional to t^(1/2). Distance x = integral v dt proportional to t^(3/2). Matches Option B (t3/2).
candidate_solve.limiting_cases: Consistent with EX-M64 and EX-M62. Demonstrates robust cross-sitting invariance of the constant-power scaling law x ~ t^(3/2).

concept_model_selection.evidence: Recognizing power-velocity relation for towed mass

representation_translation.evidence: Relating displacement to time under constant power

reasoning_chain_length.evidence: Two-step proportionality: v ~ t^(1/2) => x ~ t^(3/2)

difficulty_evidence.differences: Rescored to native five-factor rubric per B2 CP-4 review

demand_proposal.rationale: Application of constant power displacement scaling
